packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
PACKET-02 - UNVERIFIED IMAGE READING (working notes appended as images are viewed)

== image-001 (overview, face 1) with tiles image-002, -003, -004 ==

Layout: narrow horizontal strip, c. 16 cm wide by c. 1.5 cm high (ruler in image), cut across a leaf.
Two columns visible, vertical ruling lines at left of each column; blank margin at far left (c. 2.5 cm).
Only 3 lines of text per column survive in full, plus tops of a 4th line at the lower edge and descender
traces of a line above at the upper edge. Small cursive (documentary-looking) hand, brown ink, heavy
abbreviation. One red paraph and a red-touched letter in column a, line 3. Several holes.

Column a (image-002 left part, image-003 left part):
image-002 L1 / image-003 L1:  erit(?) i(n) q(u)a quis ac(?) t(ri)or(um)(?) [..]t(?) simile(?)
image-002 L2 / image-003 L2:  du(m)(?) no(n) e(st)(?) [hole] p(er) relic(?) s(ed)(?) annecc(?) q(uo)d(?) d
image-002 L3 / image-003 L3:  dixerat(?) [hole] [red paraph] alla(?) [red-touched letter] s(?)b(?) mund(?) in quib(us) [hole] ..eg(?)
image-003 L4: only tops of letters at the cut edge [illegible]

Column b (image-003 right part, image-004):
image-003 L1 / image-004 L1:  ab eo in(?) q(uod) mo(do) . [hole] eo q(uod)(?) ip(su)m(?) evenit(?) / eveniet(?)
image-003 L2 / image-004 L2:  fore(?) mo(r)tuu(m)(?) a fuit decept(us)(?) et(?) alii(?) c[..]
image-003 L3 / image-004 L3:  diu(?) fuit(?) nond(um)(?) mo(do) fore(?) mortuu(m)(?) a [..]
image-004 L4: tops only: [illegible] ... [illegible]

== image-005 (overview, face 2 or second strip) ==

Layout: strip c. 14+ cm wide by c. 3 cm high; right end cut off by the image frame/leaf edge. Two columns
with ruled frame lines; blank upper margin above line 1 in both columns (so line 1 looks like the first
line of each column - tentative). Faint offset/stamp-like mark in upper margin above column b. Left
margin damaged with holes. Same small cursive hand. One red paraph stroke in column a line 3; a red mark at
the lower edge of column b.

Column a (image-006):
image-006 L1:  ab ip(s)a ex(?) / cu(m)(?) lege(?) no(n) negat(ur)(?) q(ui)n(?) ip(s)e possit
image-006 L2:  duc(er)e alia(m) uxore(m) sicut(?) forte nec illa si
image-006 L3:  e(ss)et(?) cu(m)(?) co(n)t(ra)x(er)it(?) [red paraph] Q(ui)d(?) si aliq(ui)s m(?)[..] dedit(?)
image-006 L4:  mulieri p(ro)pt(er)(?) nu(m)mos(?) (et) si illa postea
image-006 L5:  nol(et)(?) dare nu(m)mos p(ro)pt(er) h(o)c no(n) cessaret
image-006 L6:  m(at)ri(m)o(n)iu(m) q(uia) illa de app(osi)c(i)o(n)e(?) / (con)dic(i)o(n)e(?) no(n) solvit ip(su)m
image-006 L7 (cut through at the lower edge):  [..]mo(n)iu(m)(?) s(ed) dolet(?) [illegible]

Column b (image-007; left edge of image-007 repeats the line-ends of column a = overlap with image-006):
image-007 L1:  (con)trah(er)e(?) / (con)trahit(?) m(at)ri(m)o(n)iu(m) t(ame)n(?) / t(un)c(?) [hole] inq(ui)re(re)(?) / i(n)quo(?).. [cut at right]
image-007 L2:  m(u)l(t)a(?) / ma[..] (con)t(ra)ctu(m)(?) / dicit(ur)(?) q(uia) / q(uod) tales(?) i(n) q(ui)b(us)(?) si
image-007 L3:  o(mn)es(?) / ob.. a(n)te(?) m(at)ri(m)o(n)iu(m) (con)t(ra)xisse(n)t(?) castrat(?)[..]
image-007 L4:  p(ro)pt(er) h(o)c [small hole] l(ice)t(?) aut(?) fuit(?) / sint(?) si(c)(?) m[..] [cut at right]
image-007 L5:  aliam(?) / alium(?) uxore(m) (con)t(ra)h(er)e aut(?) [superscript mark] de m[..] [cut at right]
image-007 L6 (cut through at lower edge):  i(n)(?) [hole] ..olescent(?).. a(n)i(m)i(?) / annis(?) [..] [red paraph] [..]
Note: blind-stamp or offset impression (rectangular, illegible lettering, appears inverted) in the upper
margin above column b.

== image-008 (overview, third face) with tiles image-009, image-010 ==

Layout: strip c. 13.5 cm wide by c. 3 cm high. DIFFERENT SCRIPT from images 001-007: a more formal, upright
book hand, larger module, greyer/fainter ink, word-separating medial points (possibly marking rhythmic or
rhymed cola: constantie/pudicicie, imparibus/faucibus - observation, tentative). Two columns with vertical
rulings; blank upper margin above L1 of each column (again looks like top of the columns). An enlarged
initial at the start of column b line 2, set slightly into the margin. Small interlinear glosses in column
b in a finer hand. In the upper margin above column a, one line in a small cursive hand (addition). Faint
blind-stamp/offset in upper margin of column a. Right end torn with holes. Tentative: this is the other
side of the image-005 strip (hole shapes mirror), i.e. the cursive legal-looking text and this text share a
leaf - or one is a reused/other leaf; cannot decide from images.

Column a (image-009; left edge of the strip cuts the line beginnings):
image-009 L0 (upper-margin addition, small cursive):  [..]io(?) (et) eius(?) sp(irit)u(?) / sp(ati)o(?) (et) modi(?)[..]
image-009 L1:  [..]nda(?) felle(?) [hole] [..]elita(?) castitatis mar-
image-009 L2:  [..]ita | [..]ngelica(?) / eu(an)g(e)lica(?) es(?) / eo(?) quesita . (et) nube(?) / rube(?)
image-009 L3:  [..]s hac(?) / hec(?) uirtu(?) . salutis(?) p(ro)(?) negotiato(?)[..]q(ue)(?) .
image-009 L4 (cut through at lower edge):  [..] nata(?) . clam(?) hauris(?) [..]or(?) [illegible]
(Thin vertical pen strokes stand between some words in L1-L2, e.g. after "[..]ita" - word dividers or
later marks.)

Column b (image-010; the right part of image-009 shows the same line beginnings = overlap):
image-010 L1:  constantie . O flos candens(?) nitid(?)[..] / intac-(?)
image-010 gloss above L2 (interlinear, over "lupis"):  Cel(?)[..]r(?). / Calu(?).
image-010 L2:  [enlarged initial, H- or N-like] Hec(?) [..]uma(?) / He[..]una(?) pudicicie . q(ue)(?) ut lupis tam
image-010 gloss above L3 (interlinear):  s(cilicet)(?) p(ro)(?) [..]acion(?) i(n)(?) [..]acio(?) cura(?)[..] .d(?).
image-010 L3:  imparibus . te p(re)stitisti faucibus . cur
image-010 L4 (cut through at lower edge):  [..]anim(?)[..]lia(?) que clam(?)[..] . P(re)mii(?) ob[..]

== image-011 (overview, fourth face) with tiles image-012 (left), image-013 (right) ==

Layout: L-shaped piece, c. 9.5 cm wide; the text-bearing horizontal part c. 2.8 cm high, with a blank tab
rising at the left. Same small cursive hand as images 001-007. One column of text visible (its left ruling
line preserved), 8 lines plus descenders of a line above; right edge torn so line ends may be lost by a
letter or two. Wide blank left margin carrying faint vertical brownish traces (offset or show-through, not
readable; possibly glue/board impression). One red paraph stroke in L3. Questions open with "Q(ui)d de ..."
(observed twice), like the "Q(ui)d si" on image-006.

Text (image-012 gives line beginnings, image-013 the rest; they overlap in the middle):
image-012/013 L0:  descenders only at the cut upper edge [illegible]
image-012/013 L1:  d(e)(?) q(ui)b(us)(?) / q(uan)tu(m)(?) no(n) dat(ur)(?) / d(ebe)re(?) s(e)n(tenc)iam(?) p(ro)(?) i(n)imicicia(?) m[..]
image-012/013 L2:  p(re)ced(e)ns(?) / p(re)dict(us)(?) sp(irit)ual(e) e(st) symoniacu(m)(?) p(ro)pt(er) (con)suetu-(?) / (con)sum[..]
image-012/013 L3:  d[..]e(m)(?) [red paraph] Ite(m) i(n) c(aus)a(?) m(at)ri(m)o(n)iali . s(cilicet)(?) q(uod) minor(?)
image-012/013 L4:  (con)t(ra)he(re)(?) p(er) lui(?)[..] / pl(ur)i(?) possit . Q(ui)d de h(er)eticis q(ui)(?)
image-012/013 L5:  ite(rum)(?) / ite(m)(?) cu(m)(?) baptizant(ur)(?) no(n) l(ice)t disp(e)nsare
image-012/013 L6:  cu(m) q(uo)cu(m)q(ue)(?) / q(uo)q(uam)(?) qui ordina(n)t(ur) b(e)n(e)(?) / b(is)(?) bap(ti)z(a)ti(?) inuiti(?) d[..]
image-012/013 L7:  p(re)t(er)ea(?) / s(ed)(?)[..] ordinat(os)(?) disp(e)nsare p(otes)t . Q(ui)d de ba[p]-(?)
image-012/013 L8:  tis(atis)(?) / [..]tis aut(?) / cu(m)(?) dicit bernhardus(?) q(uod)(?) p(ro)p(ter)(?) / h(oc)(?) n[..]

== image-014 (overview, fifth face = apparently the other side of the L-shaped piece of image-011) with tile image-015 ==

Layout: mirror outline of image-011 (blank tab now at upper right). Surface darker, rubbed and stained;
ink abraded, especially at left and centre. One column, 8 lines, line beginnings lost at the torn left edge
(1-3 letters), blank margin to the right. Same small cursive hand. One red paraph in L4. Readings on this
face are substantially less secure than elsewhere.

image-015 L1:  [..] q(uod)(?) p(re)ced(i)t(?) / (con)ced(i)t(ur)(?) i(n) ca(s)u(?) si ac(?) castitate(m)(?) / c(aus)arum(?) q(ui) p(ro)[..] [illegible]
image-015 L2:  [..]ula i(n)(?) p[..]icular(?)[..] q(ui)cu(m)q(ue)(?) p(os)sit(?) dare(?) / dote(m)(?) uiua(?) / n(is)i(?)
image-015 L3:  [..]hoc(?) ore(?) / o(mn)e(?) [illegible] (et)(?) sp(irit)uale(?) alii(?) si(n)g(u)l(ar)e(?) si
image-015 L4:  [..]ate(m) q(uo)cu(m)q(ue)(?) [red paraph] Q(ui)d(?) d(e)(?) [..]q(ui)b(us)(?) si aliq(ui)s h(abe)t (con)cu-(?)
image-015 L5:  [..]na(m)(?) q(uam)(?) uid(e)r(e)t(ur)(?) / uell(e)t(?) ille q(uo)d(?) dic(er)e(?) / duc(er)e(?) a(?) si ille e(st) sp(irit)ual(is)(?)
image-015 L6:  [..]morte(?) q(uam)uis(?) sci(a)t(?) / s(e)c(un)d(u)m(?) q(uod) no(n) e(st) sp(irit)ua(lis)(?) / sp(on)sa(?) de(?) ducat(?)
image-015 L7:  [..]ius(?) a(?) ip(s)a(m) pulsat(?) / p(ro)mittat(?) ne(c)(?) i(n)q(ui)ra(t)(?) / i(n)q(ui)a(m)(?) (con)sidera(n)s(?)
image-015 L8:  [..]ymale(?) / [..]ypuale(?) si(c)(?) [..] q(uod) uelit(?) ea(m) duce(re) i(n) uxore(m)(?)
(below L8: tops/tails of a further line at the cut edge, [illegible])

== image-016 (overview, sixth face) with tiles image-017 (left), image-018 (middle), image-019 (right) ==

Layout: narrow strip c. 16 cm by c. 1.3 cm, same outline as image-001 mirrored (hole shapes match), so
apparently its other side. Script here is the more formal book hand of image-008 (grey, very faded ink,
medial points), NOT the small cursive. Two lines of main text survive per column, with a small interlinear
gloss between them at the far left. Vertical rulings visible: a narrow strip of a column at far left, then
a column starting c. 3.3 cm, then another starting c. 8 cm; blank margin at right from c. 14 cm. A short
dark oblique pen stroke after the end of line 1 at right. Most of this face is too faint to read
continuously at the supplied resolution.

Far-left column remnant (image-017):
image-017 L1:  [..]aunaq(ue)(?) / [..]aurat(?)[..] [illegible]
image-017 gloss between L1 and L2:  [..]igeo(?) . / [..]ig(n)eo(?) .
image-017 L2:  [..]mitabier(?)[..] / [..]metalieri(?)[..] [illegible]

Middle column (image-017 right part, image-018 left part; overlap):
image-017 L1 / image-018 L1:  [hole] iuuentas(?) / iu[..]mitas(?) psy(?)[..] / p(ro)p(?)[..]q(ue)(?) [illegible]
image-017 L2 / image-018 L2:  [..]sto(?) . te [illegible, c. 15 letters] [hole]
(a detached rounded sign, like "e" or a "(con)" mark, sits between the lines near the hole in image-018)

Right column (image-018 right part, image-019; overlap):
image-018 L1 / image-019 L1:  [illegible, c. 8 letters] gaudio(?) [..]at(?)[..] [..]heis(?) / [..]hesis(?) ren(?)[..] [oblique pen stroke]
image-018 L2 / image-019 L2:  [..]stis(?)[..] [illegible] pugnat(?) / p(ro)ueniat(?) [hole] meta(?)m(?) / [..]ecu(m)(?) . fauor(?) / fauce(?)[..]

== Selection, overlaps, limits ==

- All legible text on every face was attempted; nothing was deliberately skipped. Unread: almost all of the
  sixth face (image-016 to -019) and the left/centre of the fifth face (image-015), from fading and
  abrasion, not from cropping. Fourth lines on image-001 and the last lines on image-005/008 are cut through.
- Pieces: (A) long narrow strip, images 001-004 (cursive side) and 016-019 (book-hand side);
  (B) wider strip, images 005-007 (cursive side) and 008-010 (book-hand side); (C) L-shaped piece,
  images 011-013 and 014-015 (cursive on both sides). The pairing of sides is inferred from mirrored outlines
  and holes only.
- Observation: two unrelated-looking scripts are present. The cursive text uses "Q(ui)d si ...", "Q(ui)d de
  ...", "Ite(m) ..." openings with red paraphs and vocabulary such as m(at)ri(m)o(n)iu(m), uxore(m),
  (con)t(ra)here, disp(e)nsare, baptiza-, ordina-, symoniacu(m)(?); one apparent personal name "bernhardus"(?)
  (image-013 L8) is cited with "dicit". The book-hand text has pointed cola with end-rhyme and interlinear
  glosses, and addresses someone in the second person ("te p(re)stitisti"). Whether the cursive is written on
  blank space/reverse of the book-hand leaf or these are different leaves cannot be settled from the images;
  on piece B both sides show a blank upper margin.
- Column order within the cursive faces is taken left to right as photographed; whether pieces A, B, C join
  or follow one another is not determinable (no line continues visibly from one piece to another).
- Abbreviation expansions in parentheses are proposals; the hand is highly abbreviated and many minims are
  ambiguous (n/u/m/i), so words marked (?) should be treated as unverified.
- Wider/better views that would help: raking-light or UV images of image-015 and image-016; higher
  magnification of the interlinear glosses on image-010.

Exposure statement: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification of the work or author. I did not
read packet.json, use the web, or open any catalogue or edition. Beyond the rules: I ran one directory
listing (ls) of the packet directory to find the image filenames, which showed that packet.json exists (not
opened). This is an unverified image reading.
